insights.body: App Total New Subs is -3.5% and App Total Install is +2.9%; the gap between them (-6.4pp) is under the 10pp we treat as a real signal, so the share of people who install and then subscribe is close to normal. New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So nothing unusual is building up that would swing App Total Revenue in about 7 days.
